expectations.note: After clearing preferences and restarting, the Dot hero showed only the pulsing dot with no song-info overlay.
The toggle was enabled through Settings; after a restart, the long-metadata overlay was still rendered.
After toggling the option off and restarting, the Dot hero again showed no artist/title overlay.
At 100%, the 60+ character artist and title wrapped inside the hero and remained visibly separated from the dot.
At 150%, the long title visibly intersected the pulsing dot in the fresh screenshot.
The fresh normal-scale reproduction was captured, but the candidate's submitted normal screenshot used the short fixture rather than long metadata.
The fresh max-scale reproduction was captured and showed overlap; the candidate's submitted max screenshot also used the short fixture.
The normal and max verification bundles' tree/semantics contained the non-empty long artist and title text alongside the screenshots.
Short fixture metadata rendered cleanly at both 100% and 150% in fresh verification captures.
The app remained live with non-zero playback and zero overflow reports after the exercise.
